answer: Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 53 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the juniper deposit is held in the dawn escrow, the karst audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases therefore burns capital on every one it does not finish. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
